cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: Sodium Laureth Sulfate #2 is the primary route, but the co-surfactants are mild anionics (Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate #5, Sodium Lauroyl Glutamate #7) and nonionic Laureth-2 #3 that buffer rather than reinforce; Panthenol #4 and PEG-120 Methyl Glucose Dioleate #10 add mildness. No reset intent.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: SLES plus two additional anionic routes and no amphoteric co-surfactant (C1's buffered pattern is not literally met)

conditioningLevel.rationale: Low: cleansing-led; one late light cationic (Polyquaternium-7 #13), Panthenol #4 humectant and late Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein #17; no silicone, oil or fatty alcohol. Manufacturer confirms deliberately low care dosing (corroborating only).

weightPotential.rationale: Low: depositionLoad light (one late light polymer, late protein), persistence low, resetCapacity moderate.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: one light polymer and late protein can remain low

focusPrimary.rationale: General: the dominant positioning is menopausal hair loss / hair-root activation, which is medically adjacent and out of scope (E2, S-HAIRLOSS) and cannot create scalp_active. Remaining claims ('Volumen behält', 'brüchiges Haar') are outcome or thickness statements: volume is a restatement of low weight; repair verdict is nonspecific (one late protein token #17, 7.3).

careDirection.limitation: single late protein token; panthenol is generic conditioning

focusPrimary.counterSignal: 'damit die Frisur ihr Volumen behält' and light formula are compatible with volume
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Formula light/nonspecific. Hair-loss claim excluded. Volume only as 'not weighing down' - not a lift/body job. Resolved general.

focusSecondary.rationale: No distinct in-scope secondary positioning with an independent route.

usageRole.rationale: Frequent: 'Täglich anwenden', 'Bei jeder Haarwäsche benutzen' and cleansingStrength moderate.
usageRole.counterSignal: daily use is tied to the out-of-scope caffeine regimen

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: No sensitive/itchy/dry-feeling scalp positioning; 'Widerstandskraft von Kopfhaut' is hair-loss context.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole; Zinc PCA is not a recognized active under §11.

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W low: fine ideal, normal ideal, coarse acceptable (C low). 'für feines Haar' is corroboration only (T2). T4: W neighbor none; C neighbor moderate keeps coarse acceptable -> no flag.
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-HAIRLOSS: only scalp-adjacent positioning is hair loss/root activation, which was not evaluated and creates no target; no E2 claim -> S-ORDINARY.
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1 moderate -> regular. I3: neighbor strong -> regular (usage would be regular, no clarifying focus) -> same intensity, no flag.

uncertainties: C1 covers ether sulfate + amphoteric buffering; it is silent on SLES buffered by mild anionics (sulfosuccinate, glutamate) with no amphoteric, while §4 says 'SLES plus additional anionic routes often supports strong'. Resolved moderate (mild anionics buffer), neighbor strong.
§7: standard does not say how to treat focus when the dominant claim is out-of-scope hair loss; resolved general rather than inferring volume from a 'not weighing down' statement.
S-HAIRLOSS requires stating the hair-loss claim was not evaluated but there is no note code for it in 13.9; recorded as a free-text informational note.
